requiredEvidence: exact serialized GameObject root or exact world-scene placement identity
hierarchy, mesh/material/texture and transform roundtrip audit
animation, skin, collider and LOD closure when present
portable semantic output path with no case-folded collision

forbiddenClaims: route tokens prove the visual category
matching mesh bytes prove one logical asset
a sole catalog owner proves a complete standalone closure

examples: lossy material or animation conversion required

promotionRule: Manual category review is necessary but not sufficient: inferred_pending_review may become verified only after the complete logical-closure gates pass.
deduplicationRule: Deduplicate only byte-identical complete logical closures with equivalent ownership evidence; never deduplicate by mesh hash alone.
